units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 1|name|2913|0
units.english: Long Lost Property
units.italian: Proprietà perduta da tempo

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 1|description|2914|0
units.english: Head to the <system> system to recover House Idriss' satellite, or try to learn what happened to it, if it isn't there.
units.italian: Dirigiti nel <system> per recuperare il satellite della Casa Idriss, oppure cerca di scoprire che fine ha fatto, se non è lì.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 1|You notice a pair of Arachi, who you assume to be spaceport workers due to their uniforms, talking while pointing to your ship. One of them is slightly shorter than most Arach you've seen, while the other is a good bit taller. They approach you after they see you noticed them, and the larger of them speaks up. "Excuse us you must, Captain, but in need of your help, we are."|2922|0
units.english: You notice a pair of Arachi, who you assume to be spaceport workers due to their uniforms, talking while pointing to your ship. One of them is slightly shorter than most Arach you've seen, while the other is a good bit taller. They approach you after they see you noticed them, and the larger of them speaks up. "Excuse us you must, Captain, but in need of your help, we are."
units.italian: Noti una coppia di Arachi, che supponi siano operai dello spazioporto per via delle uniformi, che parlano indicando la tua nave. Uno di loro è leggermente più basso della maggior parte degli Arach che hai visto, mentre l'altro è parecchio più alto. Ti si avvicinano dopo aver visto che li hai notati, e il più grande dei due prende la parola. "Scusarci dovete, capitano, ma in bisogno del vostro aiuto, noi siamo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 1|	"Work at House Idriss, we do, and looking to recover some lost property, the House is," the shorter one explains. "Accompany us to our headquarters, could you? Meet up with you, our boss-"|2923|0
units.english: "Work at House Idriss, we do, and looking to recover some lost property, the House is," the shorter one explains. "Accompany us to our headquarters, could you? Meet up with you, our boss-"
units.italian: "Lavorare per la Casa Idriss, noi lo facciamo, e recuperare una proprietà perduta, la Casa vuole," spiega il più basso. "Accompagnarci alla nostra sede, potreste? Incontrarvi, il nostro capo-"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 1|	"President," the other one interrupts him.|2924|0
units.english: "President," the other one interrupts him.
units.italian: "Presidente," lo interrompe l'altro.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 1|	"Our president will."|2925|0
units.english: "Our president will."
units.italian: "Il nostro presidente vi incontrerà."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 1|	"I've got some time. Lead the way."|2927|0
units.english: "I've got some time. Lead the way."
units.italian: "Ho un po' di tempo. Fammi strada."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 1|	"What is it that you lost?"|2929|0
units.english: "What is it that you lost?"
units.italian: "Che cosa avete perso?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 1|	"Sorry, I'm not interested."|2930|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm not interested."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non mi interessa."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 1|	"Umm... confidential information, that is," the taller one says. "If wish to learn more, you do, accompany us, you should."|2932|0
units.english: "Umm... confidential information, that is," the taller one says. "If wish to learn more, you do, accompany us, you should."
units.italian: "Ehm... informazioni riservate, sono," dice il più alto. "Se saperne di più, voi volete, accompagnarci, dovreste."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 1|	"Alright then, show me the way."|2934|0
units.english: "Alright then, show me the way."
units.italian: "Va bene allora, mostrami la strada."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 1|	"This seems a bit shady. I'll pass."|2935|0
units.english: "This seems a bit shady. I'll pass."
units.italian: "Mi sembra un po' losco. Passo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 1|	They bring you to a dead end street not far from the spaceport surrounded by various older buildings. A wide hole is at the end, almost like a subway entrance, with stairs leading dozens of meters underground. You follow them down the stairs to find something similar to a customs area, where some Arachi and Kimek in uniforms ready their stations once they see you three.|2938|0
units.english: They bring you to a dead end street not far from the spaceport surrounded by various older buildings. A wide hole is at the end, almost like a subway entrance, with stairs leading dozens of meters underground. You follow them down the stairs to find something similar to a customs area, where some Arachi and Kimek in uniforms ready their stations once they see you three.
units.italian: Ti portano in un vicolo cieco non lontano dallo spazioporto, circondato da vari edifici vecchi. Alla fine c'è un ampio buco, quasi un ingresso della metropolitana, con scale che scendono decine di metri sottoterra. Li segui giù per le scale e trovi qualcosa di simile a un'area doganale, dove alcuni Arachi e Kimek in uniforme preparano le loro postazioni appena vi vedono arrivare in tre.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 1|	You continue after some waiting, as the operators insist on manually inspecting every last bit of your electronic devices. Inside, you see a few dozen workers at their computers, with one occasionally heading to the back and taking an elevator somewhere. They seldom talk, so the only sound you can make out is that of some machinery working below you. Eventually, you're greeted by an Arach in some manner of tuxedo, or at least their equivalent to one, a blueish fabric dotted with black buttons. "Ah, Captain <last>, you must be!" she greets you. "To our corporate headquarters, I welcome you."|2939|0
units.english: You continue after some waiting, as the operators insist on manually inspecting every last bit of your electronic devices. Inside, you see a few dozen workers at their computers, with one occasionally heading to the back and taking an elevator somewhere. They seldom talk, so the only sound you can make out is that of some machinery working below you. Eventually, you're greeted by an Arach in some manner of tuxedo, or at least their equivalent to one, a blueish fabric dotted with black buttons. "Ah, Captain <last>, you must be!" she greets you. "To our corporate headquarters, I welcome you."
units.italian: Proseguite dopo un po' di attesa, dato che gli operatori insistono per ispezionare manualmente ogni singolo dispositivo elettronico che hai. Dentro, vedi qualche dozzina di lavoratori ai loro computer, uno dei quali ogni tanto va verso il fondo e prende un ascensore chissà dove. Parlano raramente, quindi l'unico suono che riesci a distinguere è quello di qualche macchinario in funzione sotto di te. Alla fine ti accoglie un Arach in una specie di smoking, o almeno l'equivalente che hanno, un tessuto bluastro punteggiato di bottoni neri. "Ah, voi dovete essere il capitano <last>!" ti saluta. "Nella nostra sede aziendale, vi do il benvenuto."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 1|	She urges you to follow her to her office, and you go along with the two Arachi who guided you here. Once you're in the office, a modest, spacious room made to accommodate the Arachi, she introduces herself. "Flopug, you may call me. Acting president of House Idriss, I am. Now, told about what we need your services for, were you?"|2940|0
units.english: She urges you to follow her to her office, and you go along with the two Arachi who guided you here. Once you're in the office, a modest, spacious room made to accommodate the Arachi, she introduces herself. "Flopug, you may call me. Acting president of House Idriss, I am. Now, told about what we need your services for, were you?"
units.italian: Ti esorta a seguirla nel suo ufficio, e tu vai con i due Arachi che ti hanno guidato fin qui. Una volta nell'ufficio, una stanza modesta e spaziosa fatta per accogliere gli Arachi, si presenta. "Flopug, potete chiamarmi. Presidente facente funzioni della Casa Idriss, io sono. Ora, vi hanno detto per cosa ci serve il vostro aiuto?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 1|	"These two told me House Idriss lost something."|2942|0
units.english: "These two told me House Idriss lost something."
units.italian: "Questi due mi hanno detto che la Casa Idriss ha perso qualcosa."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 1|	"No, not really."|2943|0
units.english: "No, not really."
units.italian: "No, non proprio."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 1|	"Nearly nine thousand years ago, before even formed, the Coalition was, launched a... probe of sorts, for a long term experiment, that time's House Idriss had," she explains. "Sent to a nearby system where a habitable planet could be, it was, accelerating to approximately half the speed of light." She taps somewhere on the desk with one of her legs, and a screen appears at the top, showing a map of the local star systems. "Recognize this one, do you?" she asks, pointing to one of the systems. "A system currently inhabited by humans, we believe it is. Arrive there, the probe soon should, if arrived already, it hasn't."|2944|0
units.english: "Nearly nine thousand years ago, before even formed, the Coalition was, launched a... probe of sorts, for a long term experiment, that time's House Idriss had," she explains. "Sent to a nearby system where a habitable planet could be, it was, accelerating to approximately half the speed of light." She taps somewhere on the desk with one of her legs, and a screen appears at the top, showing a map of the local star systems. "Recognize this one, do you?" she asks, pointing to one of the systems. "A system currently inhabited by humans, we believe it is. Arrive there, the probe soon should, if arrived already, it hasn't."
units.italian: "Quasi novemila anni fa, prima ancora che si formasse, la Coalizione era, lanciò una... sonda, più o meno, per un esperimento a lungo termine, la Casa Idriss di allora lo fece," spiega. "Inviata in un sistema vicino dove poteva esserci un pianeta abitabile, fu, accelerando fino a circa metà della velocità della luce." Batte con una zampa su un punto della scrivania, e in alto appare uno schermo che mostra una mappa dei sistemi stellari vicini. "Riconoscete questo, voi?" chiede, indicando uno dei sistemi. "Un sistema attualmente abitato dagli umani, crediamo che sia. Arrivare lì, la sonda presto dovrebbe; se già arrivata, non lo è."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 1|	Upon further inspection, you piece together the systems in the screen, and realize the system she's pointing to is <system>, just one jump away.|2945|0
units.english: Upon further inspection, you piece together the systems in the screen, and realize the system she's pointing to is <system>, just one jump away.
units.italian: Guardando meglio, ricostruisci i sistemi sullo schermo e ti rendi conto che quello che indica è <system>, a un solo salto di distanza.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 1|	"I haven't heard news of any probes entering Han."|2947|0
units.english: "I haven't heard news of any probes entering Han."
units.italian: "Non ho sentito notizie di sonde entrate in Han."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 1|	"So what do you want me to do?"|2948|0
units.english: "So what do you want me to do?"
units.italian: "Quindi cosa volete che faccia?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 1|	"No? Well, the destination for the probe, that system was. Hmm... maybe delaying itself for some extra data..." She goes quiet, lost in thought for a while.|2950|0
units.english: "No? Well, the destination for the probe, that system was. Hmm... maybe delaying itself for some extra data..." She goes quiet, lost in thought for a while.
units.italian: "No? Beh, la destinazione della sonda, quel sistema era. Hmm... magari si sta trattenendo per qualche dato in più..." Tace, persa nei pensieri per un po'.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 1|	"Need someone to retrieve the probe, we do. Designed, it was, with an artificial intelligence that would learn during the trip, so even if terribly outdated, the equipment is, possibly invaluable, the data it gathered by observing starlight could be. Or simply mildly amusing, but hoping for the former, we are."|2952|0
units.english: "Need someone to retrieve the probe, we do. Designed, it was, with an artificial intelligence that would learn during the trip, so even if terribly outdated, the equipment is, possibly invaluable, the data it gathered by observing starlight could be. Or simply mildly amusing, but hoping for the former, we are."
units.italian: "Qualcuno che recuperi la sonda, noi lo cerchiamo. Progettata, fu, con un'intelligenza artificiale che imparasse durante il viaggio, quindi anche se terribilmente obsoleto, l'equipaggiamento è, forse inestimabile, i dati raccolti osservando la luce stellare potrebbero essere. O semplicemente vagamente divertenti, ma speriamo nei primi, noi lo speriamo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 1|	"Alright, I'll go look for it."|2954|0
units.english: "Alright, I'll go look for it."
units.italian: "Va bene, andrò a cercarla."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 1|	"What if I can't find it in the system? If it hasn't arrived, would I need to wait a long time for it to get there?"|2956|0
units.english: "What if I can't find it in the system? If it hasn't arrived, would I need to wait a long time for it to get there?"
units.italian: "E se non riesco a trovarla nel sistema? Se non è ancora arrivata, dovrei aspettare a lungo che arrivi?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 1|	"What's in it for me?"|2958|0
units.english: "What's in it for me?"
units.italian: "E io che ci guadagno?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 1|	"Pay you handsomely for the retrieval, House Idriss would," she answers. "Also, if of any use, the data is, adapted to deep space, the artificial intelligence may have done. New technologies, this could provide us, and to you we would share such a prize."|2959|0
units.english: "Pay you handsomely for the retrieval, House Idriss would," she answers. "Also, if of any use, the data is, adapted to deep space, the artificial intelligence may have done. New technologies, this could provide us, and to you we would share such a prize."
units.italian: "Pagarvi profumatamente per il recupero, la Casa Idriss lo farebbe," risponde. "Inoltre, se di qualche utilità, i dati sono, adattarsi allo spazio profondo, l'intelligenza artificiale potrebbe averlo fatto. Nuove tecnologie, questo potrebbe darci, e a voi condivideremmo un tale premio."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 1|	"Not too long," the short Arach answers. "Minor changes in its speed, the probe might have had, but delay its arrival for more than a few weeks, it could not. One week from now, the absolute limit date for its arrival is."|2962|0
units.english: "Not too long," the short Arach answers. "Minor changes in its speed, the probe might have had, but delay its arrival for more than a few weeks, it could not. One week from now, the absolute limit date for its arrival is."
units.italian: "Non troppo a lungo," risponde l'Arach più basso. "Piccoli cambiamenti nella sua velocità, la sonda potrebbe averli avuti, ma ritardare il suo arrivo di più di qualche settimana, non avrebbe potuto. Una settimana da oggi, il limite assoluto per il suo arrivo è."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 1|	"If locate it immediately, you do not, maybe ask the local humans you could," the taller one adds. "Newsworthy in most systems, such an event would be."|2963|0
units.english: "If locate it immediately, you do not, maybe ask the local humans you could," the taller one adds. "Newsworthy in most systems, such an event would be."
units.italian: "Se individuarla subito, voi non riuscite, magari chiedere agli umani del posto potreste," aggiunge il più alto. "Da prima pagina nella maggior parte dei sistemi, un evento così sarebbe."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 1|	They show you an image of the probe, which looks pretty much like an ordinary satellite, and say they'll work on your ship's scanning system to pick up the object's signature easier. Flopug says goodbye and tells you she must continue working, but has the two Arachi bring you back to your ship and adjust your scanners. They wish you good luck once they're done, and leave your ship.|2965|0
units.english: They show you an image of the probe, which looks pretty much like an ordinary satellite, and say they'll work on your ship's scanning system to pick up the object's signature easier. Flopug says goodbye and tells you she must continue working, but has the two Arachi bring you back to your ship and adjust your scanners. They wish you good luck once they're done, and leave your ship.
units.italian: Ti mostrano un'immagine della sonda, che assomiglia più o meno a un satellite qualunque, e dicono che lavoreranno sul sistema di scansione della nave per captare più facilmente la firma dell'oggetto. Flopug si congeda e dice che deve tornare al lavoro, ma incarica i due Arachi di riportarti alla nave e di regolare i tuoi scanner. Ti augurano buona fortuna quando hanno finito, e lasciano la nave.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 1|dialog|2968|0
units.english: You let your scanners work for a few minutes, but they don't manage to locate House Idriss' probe. It might not yet have arrived in the system, but it would be best to look for information on Darkstone.
units.italian: Lasci lavorare gli scanner per qualche minuto, ma non riescono a individuare la sonda della Casa Idriss. Potrebbe non essere ancora arrivata nel sistema, ma sarebbe meglio cercare informazioni su Darkstone.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 2|name|2972|0
units.english: Lost and Found
units.italian: Smarrimento e ritrovamento

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 2|description|2973|0
units.english: Head to <planet>, base of the pirate who scavenged House Idriss' probe, and try to get it back from him.
units.italian: Dirigiti su <planet>, la base del pirata che ha recuperato la sonda della Casa Idriss, e prova a riprendergliela.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 2|After looking up the recent local news, you feel relieved as you won't need to wait for the probe to arrive: average headlines like "Unidentified Object Enters Han" or more sensationalist ones like "Doomsday Drone! What YOU Can Do In the Face of Impending Doom" were all the rage a few weeks ago, when the probe first arrived. None of them detail what happened to it, though, so you decide to ask the planet's inhabitants.|2980|0
units.english: After looking up the recent local news, you feel relieved as you won't need to wait for the probe to arrive: average headlines like "Unidentified Object Enters Han" or more sensationalist ones like "Doomsday Drone! What YOU Can Do In the Face of Impending Doom" were all the rage a few weeks ago, when the probe first arrived. None of them detail what happened to it, though, so you decide to ask the planet's inhabitants.
units.italian: Dopo aver consultato le notizie locali recenti, ti senti sollevato perché non dovrai aspettare l'arrivo della sonda: titoli medi come "Oggetto non identificato entra in Han" o altri più sensazionalistici come "Drone del giorno del giudizio! Cosa PUOI fare davanti all'imminente fine" andavano per la maggiore qualche settimana fa, quando la sonda è arrivata. Nessuno di essi però racconta cosa le sia successo, quindi decidi di chiedere agli abitanti del pianeta.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 2|	The spaceport workers you ask don't seem to know much more than the fact that it entered the system weeks ago, and some of the locals seem to have believed the more dramatic headlines, getting worried when you bring it up. When you reach the local produce market, one of the farmers you ask sheds some light on the issue. "A band of pirates passed by here just a few days after I watched the news about that machine. They were here for the usual, getting food from us as tribute. Must've read the news while they were here. One of them asked me about it, if we had seen it do anything dangerous. I said no, and he muttered something about selling it in a junkyard."|2981|0
units.english: The spaceport workers you ask don't seem to know much more than the fact that it entered the system weeks ago, and some of the locals seem to have believed the more dramatic headlines, getting worried when you bring it up. When you reach the local produce market, one of the farmers you ask sheds some light on the issue. "A band of pirates passed by here just a few days after I watched the news about that machine. They were here for the usual, getting food from us as tribute. Must've read the news while they were here. One of them asked me about it, if we had seen it do anything dangerous. I said no, and he muttered something about selling it in a junkyard."
units.italian: Gli operai dello spazioporto a cui chiedi non sembrano saperne più del fatto che è entrata nel sistema settimane fa, e alcuni del posto sembrano aver creduto ai titoli più drammatici, preoccupandosi quando ne parli. Quando arrivi al mercato dei prodotti locali, uno degli agricoltori a cui chiedi fa un po' di luce sulla questione. "Una banda di pirati è passata di qui pochi giorni dopo che avevo visto le notizie su quella macchina. Erano qui per il solito, prendere cibo da noi come tributo. Devono aver letto le notizie mentre erano qui. Uno di loro mi ha chiesto se l'avessimo vista fare qualcosa di pericoloso. Gli ho detto di no, e ha borbottato qualcosa sul venderla in un deposito di rottami."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 2|	"Did you catch his name?"|2983|0
units.english: "Did you catch his name?"
units.italian: "Hai sentito il suo nome?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 2|	"Do you know where he went to sell it?"|2985|0
units.english: "Do you know where he went to sell it?"
units.italian: "Sai dove è andato a venderla?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 2|	"No, but I'd guess <planet>. It's the biggest hub for their kind of activity around these parts."|2986|0
units.english: "No, but I'd guess <planet>. It's the biggest hub for their kind of activity around these parts."
units.italian: "No, ma immagino <planet>. È il centro più grande per il loro genere di attività da queste parti."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 2|	He snickers lightly, shaking his head. "I don't keep a list of their names. It's rare enough that any of them come around more than once, most get blown out of the sky before they get the chance. It's a short life they lead, those gangs from <planet>."|2989|0
units.english: He snickers lightly, shaking his head. "I don't keep a list of their names. It's rare enough that any of them come around more than once, most get blown out of the sky before they get the chance. It's a short life they lead, those gangs from <planet>."
units.italian: Ridacchia piano, scuotendo la testa. "Non tengo una lista dei loro nomi. È già raro che qualcuno di loro torni più di una volta, la maggior parte viene abbattuta in cielo prima di averne la possibilità. È una vita breve quella che fanno, le bande di <planet>."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 2|	You thank him for the information, and decide to head to <destination> to see if you can find the pirate who scavenged the probe, or the junkyard he sold it to.|2991|0
units.english: You thank him for the information, and decide to head to <destination> to see if you can find the pirate who scavenged the probe, or the junkyard he sold it to.
units.italian: Lo ringrazi per le informazioni, e decidi di dirigerti su <destination> per vedere se riesci a trovare il pirata che ha recuperato la sonda, o il deposito di rottami a cui l'ha venduta.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 3|name|3002|0
units.english: Reclaim the Probe
units.italian: Recuperare la sonda

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 3|description|3003|0
units.english: Search around pirate systems outside the South, and find the fleet that stole the probe. When you find it, bring it back to <destination>.
units.italian: Cerca nei sistemi pirata fuori dal Sud e trova la flotta che ha rubato la sonda. Quando la trovi, riportala su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 3|When you ask one of the market organizers about a local pirate returning with an alien probe, you find out he already sold it. You are then pointed to a large, surprisingly well-kept junkyard, which is something of a miniature shipyard: a few crews work on their ships in the vicinity, adding or switching parts for those they just bought. The junkyard itself is surrounded by half a dozen concrete buildings, with defensive turrets on top. A few excavators and bulldozers move ship pieces and other components around, trying to keep everything organized.|3010|0
units.english: When you ask one of the market organizers about a local pirate returning with an alien probe, you find out he already sold it. You are then pointed to a large, surprisingly well-kept junkyard, which is something of a miniature shipyard: a few crews work on their ships in the vicinity, adding or switching parts for those they just bought. The junkyard itself is surrounded by half a dozen concrete buildings, with defensive turrets on top. A few excavators and bulldozers move ship pieces and other components around, trying to keep everything organized.
units.italian: Quando chiedi a uno degli organizzatori del mercato di un pirata locale tornato con una sonda aliena, scopri che l'ha già venduta. Ti mandano quindi in un grande deposito di rottami, sorprendentemente ben tenuto, che è una specie di cantiere navale in miniatura: alcuni equipaggi lavorano sulle loro navi lì intorno, aggiungendo o cambiando pezzi per quelli appena comprati. Il deposito è circondato da una mezza dozzina di edifici di cemento, con torrette difensive sopra. Alcuni escavatori e bulldozer spostano pezzi di nave e altri componenti, cercando di tenere tutto in ordine.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 3|	You tell one of the workers you're looking for the probe, and they leave for a few minutes, heading inside the gray building by the entrance.|3011|0
units.english: You tell one of the workers you're looking for the probe, and they leave for a few minutes, heading inside the gray building by the entrance.
units.italian: Dici a uno degli operai che stai cercando la sonda, e lui si allontana per qualche minuto, dirigendosi nell'edificio grigio vicino all'ingresso.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 3|	They come back alone, saying, "Boss has looked you up, and found your pockets a bit empty. If you want that kind of information, come back when you're ready to pay."|3014|0
units.english: They come back alone, saying, "Boss has looked you up, and found your pockets a bit empty. If you want that kind of information, come back when you're ready to pay."
units.italian: Torna da solo, dicendo: "Il capo ha dato un'occhiata a te, e ha trovato le tue tasche un po' vuote. Se vuoi quel tipo di informazione, torna quando sei pronto a pagare."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 3|	When they come back, they beckon you to go inside, bringing you to a simple office where a middle-aged, balding man is waiting. "So, I hear you're looking for my latest big acquisition? Mind telling me what has you so interested in it?"|3017|0
units.english: When they come back, they beckon you to go inside, bringing you to a simple office where a middle-aged, balding man is waiting. "So, I hear you're looking for my latest big acquisition? Mind telling me what has you so interested in it?"
units.italian: Quando tornano, ti fanno cenno di entrare, portandoti in un ufficio semplice dove aspetta un uomo di mezza età, calvo. "Allora, ho sentito che stai cercando la mia ultima grande acquisizione? Ti dispiace dirmi cosa ti interessa tanto?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 3|	"I was hired to get it for someone."|3019|0
units.english: "I was hired to get it for someone."
units.italian: "Sono stato assunto per recuperarla per qualcuno."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 3|	"No reason."|3020|0
units.english: "No reason."
units.italian: "Nessun motivo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 3|	He grins. "Well, you're out of luck, it was sold the day after I got it. Damn shame I couldn't make more advertisement out of it, but the offer was too good." He gets up from his chair, and leans on the table, looking at you. "Now, I like to keep business organized around here, so of course, I know a thing or two about who the buyers were. I can't just tell you, though, I deal with dangerous people at times. One day I tell you where they are, the other there's a fleet ready to tear down my business here. If I had, say, a million credits to hire some helpers in case that happened..."|3021|0
units.english: He grins. "Well, you're out of luck, it was sold the day after I got it. Damn shame I couldn't make more advertisement out of it, but the offer was too good." He gets up from his chair, and leans on the table, looking at you. "Now, I like to keep business organized around here, so of course, I know a thing or two about who the buyers were. I can't just tell you, though, I deal with dangerous people at times. One day I tell you where they are, the other there's a fleet ready to tear down my business here. If I had, say, a million credits to hire some helpers in case that happened..."
units.italian: Sorride. "Beh, sei sfortunato, è stata venduta il giorno dopo che l'ho presa. Peccato non averci potuto fare più pubblicità, ma l'offerta era troppo buona." Si alza dalla sedia e si appoggia al tavolo, guardandoti. "Ora, mi piace tenere gli affari in ordine da queste parti, quindi ovviamente so qualcosa su chi fossero i compratori. Non posso dirtelo così, però, a volte ho a che fare con gente pericolosa. Un giorno ti dico dove sono, il giorno dopo c'è una flotta pronta a demolirmi l'attività. Se avessi, diciamo, un milione di crediti per assumere qualche aiutante nel caso succedesse..."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 3|	"When I'm done they won't have a fleet to come here. A hundred thousand should be enough of a tip for pointing me their way."|3023|0
units.english: "When I'm done they won't have a fleet to come here. A hundred thousand should be enough of a tip for pointing me their way."
units.italian: "Quando avrò finito non avranno una flotta da mandare qui. Centomila dovrebbero bastare come mancia per indicarmi la strada."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 3|	"Fine, just tell me already."|3024|0
units.english: "Fine, just tell me already."
units.italian: "Va bene, dimmi e basta."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 3|	He stares at you for a few seconds, and lets out a laugh. "Well, it was worth a try. Alright, a hundred thousand it is."|3031|0
units.english: He stares at you for a few seconds, and lets out a laugh. "Well, it was worth a try. Alright, a hundred thousand it is."
units.italian: Ti fissa per qualche secondo, poi scoppia a ridere. "Beh, valeva la pena provarci. Va bene, centomila."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 3|	"Now I can't just trust you to get every last one of their ships, can I?" he replies. "If you want to make it worth for me, it's a million. If you're not interested, there's nothing I can do about it."|3034|0
units.english: "Now I can't just trust you to get every last one of their ships, can I?" he replies. "If you want to make it worth for me, it's a million. If you're not interested, there's nothing I can do about it."
units.italian: "Ora non posso fidarmi che tu prenda ogni singola loro nave, no?" risponde. "Se vuoi che ne valga la pena per me, è un milione. Se non ti interessa, non posso farci nulla."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 3|	"Fine, just tell me already."|3040|0
units.english: "Fine, just tell me already."
units.italian: "Va bene, dimmi e basta."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 3|	"Thank you for your patronage," he says, and sits back down.|3044|0
units.english: "Thank you for your patronage," he says, and sits back down.
units.italian: "Grazie per il tuo contributo," dice, e si risiede.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 3|	"The men who approached me for the machine are pirates, though I imagine you already had that figured out," he begins. "They aren't from the south though, I could tell you that much. Older, better dressed. Said they had read the reports about the 'unknown probe' entering Han, and wanted it for their business. I asked how they intended to use it, nobody here had figured how it worked, but they said they'd find a way to make use of it, have it serve as some kind of surveillance equipment, or something like that."|3046|0
units.english: "The men who approached me for the machine are pirates, though I imagine you already had that figured out," he begins. "They aren't from the south though, I could tell you that much. Older, better dressed. Said they had read the reports about the 'unknown probe' entering Han, and wanted it for their business. I asked how they intended to use it, nobody here had figured how it worked, but they said they'd find a way to make use of it, have it serve as some kind of surveillance equipment, or something like that."
units.italian: "Gli uomini che mi hanno avvicinato per la macchina sono pirati, anche se immagino che tu l'abbia già capito," comincia. "Non sono del sud, però, questo te lo posso dire. Più vecchi, vestiti meglio. Dicevano di aver letto i rapporti sulla 'sonda sconosciuta' entrata in Han, e la volevano per i loro affari. Ho chiesto come pensavano di usarla, nessuno qui aveva capito come funzionasse, ma hanno detto che avrebbero trovato il modo di usarla, di farla servire come una specie di attrezzatura di sorveglianza, o qualcosa del genere."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 3|	"What do you think they meant by that?"|3048|0
units.english: "What do you think they meant by that?"
units.italian: "Cosa pensi che intendessero?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 3|	"Did you catch their names?"|3050|0
units.english: "Did you catch their names?"
units.italian: "Hai sentito i loro nomi?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 3|	"Did they tell me their names? Yes. Their real ones? Doubt it. They seemed organized enough that they wanted to keep that information hidden. I did get a look at their ships while we were loading the product into one of them, though."|3051|0
units.english: "Did they tell me their names? Yes. Their real ones? Doubt it. They seemed organized enough that they wanted to keep that information hidden. I did get a look at their ships while we were loading the product into one of them, though."
units.italian: "Se mi hanno detto i loro nomi? Sì. Quelli veri? Ne dubito. Sembravano abbastanza organizzati da voler tenere nascosta quell'informazione. Però ho dato un'occhiata alle loro navi mentre caricavamo il prodotto su una di esse."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 3|	He shrugs, "My guess is their base is behind some bottleneck, so they wanted something that could tell them in advance if any Navy or bounty hunter was coming for them. I did get to look at their ships, seemed very well equipped for running away, if they knew someone was coming."|3054|0
units.english: He shrugs, "My guess is their base is behind some bottleneck, so they wanted something that could tell them in advance if any Navy or bounty hunter was coming for them. I did get to look at their ships, seemed very well equipped for running away, if they knew someone was coming."
units.italian: Scrolla le spalle: "La mia ipotesi è che la loro base sia dietro qualche collo di bottiglia, quindi volevano qualcosa che dicesse in anticipo se stava arrivando la Marina o un cacciatore di taglie. Ho visto le loro navi, sembravano molto ben equipaggiate per scappare, se sapevano che qualcuno stava arrivando."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 3|	He tells you the ship the probe was loaded onto was a Quicksilver, heavily modified to make for a stronger warship. You walk out of the junkyard with the information, and prepare your ship to look for the pirates.|3056|0
units.english: He tells you the ship the probe was loaded onto was a Quicksilver, heavily modified to make for a stronger warship. You walk out of the junkyard with the information, and prepare your ship to look for the pirates.
units.italian: Ti dice che la nave su cui è stata caricata la sonda era un Quicksilver, pesantemente modificato per diventare una nave da guerra più potente. Esci dal deposito con l'informazione, e prepari la nave a cercare i pirati.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 3|dialog|3059|0
units.english: Entering the system, your scanners catch a trio of heavily modified Quicksilvers. They also inform you that the probe is in the system, though it fails at giving you its exact location, as if something is causing interference. The Quicksilvers notice you and ready their guns.
units.italian: Entrando nel sistema, i tuoi scanner captano un terzetto di Quicksilver pesantemente modificati. Ti informano anche che la sonda è nel sistema, anche se non riescono a darti la sua posizione esatta, come se qualcosa stesse causando interferenze. I Quicksilver ti notano e preparano i cannoni.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 3|The pirates are waiting for you when you board their Quicksilver, and you exchange shots for a while. Once you've cleared the entrance, you explore the ship, and find what should be the probe - it matches what you were shown by House Idriss' workers, if with a lot of extra wiring wrapped around it. The pirates must have tinkered with it in attempts to use it as a warning system about incoming fleets. You remove the wires, free the probe from its attachments to the ship, and let it loose into the void. You then hurry back to your ship, and catch the drifting probe into your hold. Now you need only bring it back to House Idriss.|3068|0
units.english: The pirates are waiting for you when you board their Quicksilver, and you exchange shots for a while. Once you've cleared the entrance, you explore the ship, and find what should be the probe - it matches what you were shown by House Idriss' workers, if with a lot of extra wiring wrapped around it. The pirates must have tinkered with it in attempts to use it as a warning system about incoming fleets. You remove the wires, free the probe from its attachments to the ship, and let it loose into the void. You then hurry back to your ship, and catch the drifting probe into your hold. Now you need only bring it back to House Idriss.
units.italian: I pirati ti aspettano quando sali sul loro Quicksilver, e vi scambiate colpi per un po'. Una volta ripulita l'entrata, esplori la nave e trovi quella che dovrebbe essere la sonda: corrisponde a quella che ti hanno mostrato gli operai della Casa Idriss, anche se con parecchi fili in più avvolti intorno. I pirati devono averla armeggiata per usarla come sistema di allarme per le flotte in arrivo. Togli i fili, liberi la sonda dai suoi attacchi alla nave e la lasci andare nel vuoto. Poi torni di corsa alla tua nave e catturi la sonda alla deriva nella stiva. Ora devi solo riportarla alla Casa Idriss.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 3|After you land, you head to the underground base of House Idriss, where Flopug meets with you again. "Arrange for the probe to be brought here at once, I will," she says, dispatching some workers to where your ship is. After a few minutes, she is informed that it's secured in the "lower levels," and heads there herself to take a look at what data it gathered.|3076|0
units.english: After you land, you head to the underground base of House Idriss, where Flopug meets with you again. "Arrange for the probe to be brought here at once, I will," she says, dispatching some workers to where your ship is. After a few minutes, she is informed that it's secured in the "lower levels," and heads there herself to take a look at what data it gathered.
units.italian: Dopo l'atterraggio, ti dirigi alla base sotterranea della Casa Idriss, dove Flopug ti incontra di nuovo. "Far portare la sonda qui subito, io lo farò," dice, mandando alcuni operai dove si trova la tua nave. Dopo qualche minuto, le viene riferito che è al sicuro nei "livelli inferiori", e va lì di persona a dare un'occhiata ai dati raccolti.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 3|	When she returns, followed by the Arach duo who brought you here the first time, she hands you <payment>. "Registers of some attempts at breaching the probe's security, there are, but compromised the data, thankfully none of them have. A most curious path, its AI took," she says. "As fine-tuned as our current systems, it is not, but developed its algorithms to better determine the current status of distant stars, it has. Still going over the data, we are, so how accurate it became, we don't yet know."|3077|0
units.english: When she returns, followed by the Arach duo who brought you here the first time, she hands you <payment>. "Registers of some attempts at breaching the probe's security, there are, but compromised the data, thankfully none of them have. A most curious path, its AI took," she says. "As fine-tuned as our current systems, it is not, but developed its algorithms to better determine the current status of distant stars, it has. Still going over the data, we are, so how accurate it became, we don't yet know."
units.italian: Quando torna, seguita dal duo di Arachi che ti aveva portato qui la prima volta, ti consegna <payment>. "Registri di alcuni tentativi di violare la sicurezza della sonda, ci sono, ma compromesso i dati, fortunatamente nessuno di essi lo ha. Un percorso molto curioso, la sua IA ha preso," dice. "Tanto ottimizzato quanto i nostri sistemi attuali, non è, ma ha sviluppato i suoi algoritmi per determinare meglio lo stato attuale di stelle lontane. Ancora esaminando i dati, noi siamo, quindi quanto accurata sia diventata, non lo sappiamo ancora."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 3|	The other Arachi tell you they'll meet you in the spaceport once they finish checking the data, as they'd like you to check a system personally in order to compare it with what the probe's information. They accompany you to the staircase leading back to the street, then head back to continue analyzing the data.|3078|0
units.english: The other Arachi tell you they'll meet you in the spaceport once they finish checking the data, as they'd like you to check a system personally in order to compare it with what the probe's information. They accompany you to the staircase leading back to the street, then head back to continue analyzing the data.
units.italian: Gli altri Arachi ti dicono che ti incontreranno allo spazioporto una volta finito di controllare i dati, dato che vorrebbero che tu visitassi personalmente un sistema per confrontarlo con le informazioni della sonda. Ti accompagnano fino alla scala che riporta in strada, poi tornano a continuare l'analisi dei dati.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 3A|You fight you way through the ship, but after you search the cargo hold and outfits in the Quicksilver, you realize the probe must be in another ship.|3095|0
units.english: You fight you way through the ship, but after you search the cargo hold and outfits in the Quicksilver, you realize the probe must be in another ship.
units.italian: Ti fai strada combattendo attraverso la nave, ma dopo aver perquisito la stiva e gli equipaggiamenti del Quicksilver ti rendi conto che la sonda deve essere su un'altra nave.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 3B|After walking in the oddly empty vessel for a while, you hear an alarm sound and see pirates rushing to you from a door they blast open. You head back to your ship, avoiding what shots come your way as best as you can, and quickly close off the entrance on your side. When you look at the Quicksilver again, you see its self-destruction sequence is starting.|3116|0
units.english: After walking in the oddly empty vessel for a while, you hear an alarm sound and see pirates rushing to you from a door they blast open. You head back to your ship, avoiding what shots come your way as best as you can, and quickly close off the entrance on your side. When you look at the Quicksilver again, you see its self-destruction sequence is starting.
units.italian: Dopo aver camminato per un po' nella nave stranamente vuota, senti suonare un allarme e vedi i pirati correrti addosso da una porta che fanno saltare. Torni alla tua nave, schivando come meglio puoi i colpi che ti arrivano, e chiudi rapidamente l'ingresso dalla tua parte. Quando guardi di nuovo il Quicksilver, vedi che la sua sequenza di autodistruzione è iniziata.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 4|name|3124|0
units.english: Comparing Binaries
units.italian: Confrontare le binarie

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 4|description|3125|0
units.english: Head to <waypoints> to gather data on the binary stars, so that House Idriss may compare it with their probe's own predictions.
units.italian: Dirigiti su <waypoints> per raccogliere dati sulle stelle binarie, così che la Casa Idriss possa confrontarli con le previsioni della sua sonda.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 4|The Arach duo greet you in the spaceport and ask you to bring them inside your ship to talk. They look to the sides and behind them every other moment, as if watching out for something. When you're inside your ship's command room, the taller one speaks. "Compared the probe's prediction with its last reading of the system of arrival, we have. A very good approximation to real conditions, it reached. Though incredibly outdated, its hardware is, an ingenious program, what my ancestors-"|3132|0
units.english: The Arach duo greet you in the spaceport and ask you to bring them inside your ship to talk. They look to the sides and behind them every other moment, as if watching out for something. When you're inside your ship's command room, the taller one speaks. "Compared the probe's prediction with its last reading of the system of arrival, we have. A very good approximation to real conditions, it reached. Though incredibly outdated, its hardware is, an ingenious program, what my ancestors-"
units.italian: Il duo di Arachi ti saluta allo spazioporto e ti chiede di farli entrare nella nave per parlare. Guardano ai lati e dietro di sé ogni due per tre, come se stessero attenti a qualcosa. Quando siete nella stanza di comando della nave, il più alto prende la parola. "Confrontato le previsioni della sonda con la sua ultima lettura del sistema di arrivo, noi lo abbiamo. Un'ottima approssimazione alle condizioni reali, ha raggiunto. Anche se incredibilmente obsoleto, il suo hardware è, un programma ingegnoso, quello che i miei antenati-"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 4|	"Our ancestors," the short one interrupts him.|3133|0
units.english: "Our ancestors," the short one interrupts him.
units.italian: "I nostri antenati," lo interrompe il più basso.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 4|	"What our ancestors created is."|3134|0
units.english: "What our ancestors created is."
units.italian: "Quello che i nostri antenati hanno creato, è."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 4|	They show you a device with a map on screen, depicting nearby star systems, and the short Arach starts explaining. "Intrigued as to just how accurate its predictions have become, we are, so to verify its data about a star deeper in human space, the next step is." He points to a system at the edge of the map. "Have humans discovered this system, Captain? Interested in comparing the probe's data on far away binary stars, the president is."|3135|0
units.english: They show you a device with a map on screen, depicting nearby star systems, and the short Arach starts explaining. "Intrigued as to just how accurate its predictions have become, we are, so to verify its data about a star deeper in human space, the next step is." He points to a system at the edge of the map. "Have humans discovered this system, Captain? Interested in comparing the probe's data on far away binary stars, the president is."
units.italian: Ti mostrano un dispositivo con una mappa sullo schermo, che raffigura i sistemi stellari vicini, e l'Arach più basso comincia a spiegare. "Incuriositi di quanto accurate siano diventate le sue previsioni, noi siamo, quindi verificare i suoi dati su una stella più in profondità nello spazio umano, il prossimo passo è." Indica un sistema al bordo della mappa. "Gli umani hanno scoperto questo sistema, capitano? Interessata a confrontare i dati della sonda sulle stelle binarie lontane, la presidente è."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 4|	You look at the screen and at your own map for a moment, and recognize the system as <waypoints>. "Settled it is, then. Head to that system, you should," the taller one speaks again. "Still with our adjustments, your scanners are, so just tinker them a bit to gather the needed data, we will."|3136|0
units.english: You look at the screen and at your own map for a moment, and recognize the system as <waypoints>. "Settled it is, then. Head to that system, you should," the taller one speaks again. "Still with our adjustments, your scanners are, so just tinker them a bit to gather the needed data, we will."
units.italian: Guardi lo schermo e la tua mappa per un momento, e riconosci il sistema come <waypoints>. "Deciso è, allora. Dirigervi in quel sistema, dovreste," parla di nuovo il più alto. "Ancora con le nostre regolazioni, i vostri scanner sono, quindi ritoccarli un po' per raccogliere i dati necessari, noi lo faremo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 4|	Once they're done with your scanners a few minutes later, they leave your ship and wish you good luck.|3137|0
units.english: Once they're done with your scanners a few minutes later, they leave your ship and wish you good luck.
units.italian: Quando hanno finito con i tuoi scanner qualche minuto dopo, lasciano la nave e ti augurano buona fortuna.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 4|dialog|3140|0
units.english: One of your monitors brings up various sets of data written in the Arach language when you enter the system, and your scanners begin gathering the data House Idriss wants. A few minutes pass until a loading bar comes up. When it reaches the end, another one appears, and the process repeats a few more times. After about an hour, your monitor goes back to normal.
units.italian: Uno dei tuoi monitor mostra varie serie di dati scritte in lingua Arach quando entri nel sistema, e i tuoi scanner cominciano a raccogliere i dati che la Casa Idriss vuole. Passano alcuni minuti finché non compare una barra di caricamento. Quando arriva alla fine, ne appare un'altra, e il processo si ripete ancora qualche volta. Dopo circa un'ora, il monitor torna alla normalità.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 4|Flopug is waiting by the landing bays for you, with the Arach duo beside her. They come inside your ship when you've landed, and start checking the data, after Flopug pays you <payment>.|3145|0
units.english: Flopug is waiting by the landing bays for you, with the Arach duo beside her. They come inside your ship when you've landed, and start checking the data, after Flopug pays you <payment>.
units.italian: Flopug ti aspetta vicino agli hangar di atterraggio, con il duo di Arachi accanto. Entrano nella nave quando sei atterrato e cominciano a controllare i dati, dopo che Flopug ti ha pagato <payment>.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 4|	"Umm... more errors with this one, the probe committed," the taller Arach says. "Gotten a good deal right, it still did, but a shame it is, that deal with that much more of a distance, it couldn't."|3146|0
units.english: "Umm... more errors with this one, the probe committed," the taller Arach says. "Gotten a good deal right, it still did, but a shame it is, that deal with that much more of a distance, it couldn't."
units.italian: "Ehm... più errori con questo, la sonda ha commesso," dice l'Arach più alto. "Fatto un buon lavoro comunque, ha fatto, ma peccato è, che con una distanza molto maggiore, non potesse."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 4|	"Not distance, the cause of errors was," the short Arach responds. "Confused with the binaries' signatures, it got. Refined to account for binary star systems and their oddities, its algorithms had to be."|3147|0
units.english: "Not distance, the cause of errors was," the short Arach responds. "Confused with the binaries' signatures, it got. Refined to account for binary star systems and their oddities, its algorithms had to be."
units.italian: "Non la distanza, la causa degli errori era," risponde l'Arach più basso. "Confusa dalle firme delle binarie, è diventata. Raffinati per tenere conto dei sistemi binari e delle loro stranezze, i suoi algoritmi hanno dovuto essere."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 4|	"At any rate, happy to call the probe's voyage a success, I am," Flopug cuts them off. "Expected it to have developed this well, we hadn't, when notified of its existence by... I mean, when remember about the approaching date of its arrival to that system, we did."|3148|0
units.english: "At any rate, happy to call the probe's voyage a success, I am," Flopug cuts them off. "Expected it to have developed this well, we hadn't, when notified of its existence by... I mean, when remember about the approaching date of its arrival to that system, we did."
units.italian: "In ogni caso, felice di dichiarare riuscito il viaggio della sonda, io sono," li interrompe Flopug. "Che si sviluppasse così bene, non ce lo aspettavamo, quando avvisati della sua esistenza da... voglio dire, quando ricordato la data imminente del suo arrivo in quel sistema, noi lo abbiamo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Long Lost Property 4|	They turn your scanners back to normal, telling you that they'll work on using the data to develop a new piece of scanning equipment. They also tell you that they will let you know about it when it's ready, the next time you're on <origin>, though it may be many months before they're ready. After thanking you for your help once again, the three Arachi leave your ship.|3149|0
units.english: They turn your scanners back to normal, telling you that they'll work on using the data to develop a new piece of scanning equipment. They also tell you that they will let you know about it when it's ready, the next time you're on <origin>, though it may be many months before they're ready. After thanking you for your help once again, the three Arachi leave your ship.

Mentre la <ship> si posa sull'hangar, la piattaforma aziona rumorosamente ingranaggi e catene, e comincia presto a portare la nave, e te, in profondità nella struttura, con le porte dell'hangar che si chiudono sopra di te poco dopo. Quando l'ascensore si ferma, tu e Flopug uscite in qualcosa che è una via di mezzo tra un fornitore di equipaggiamento della Coalizione e la sede della Casa Idriss. Diversi Arachi lavorano alle loro postazioni, la maggior parte intenta a un grande amalgama di antenne parabole e sensori. Sempre guardando la scena, ora però in formazioni, gli agenti Heliarchs sussurrano tra loro, spostando raramente gli occhi, come se assistessero a uno spettacolo.

units.english: Saryds are an alien species who look suspiciously similar to the centaurs found in early human mythology. They prefer to live on worlds with as much green space as possible, and even their major cities are full of parks and gardens. Most Saryds live in small communes with up to a few dozen of them per house.
units.italian: I Saryd sono una specie aliena che assomiglia in modo sospetto ai centauri della mitologia umana più antica. Preferiscono vivere su mondi con quanta più vegetazione possibile, e persino le loro città principali sono piene di parchi e giardini. La maggior parte dei Saryd vive in piccole comuni, con fino a qualche dozzina di persone per casa.

units.id: mission:Heliarchs Buy Jump Drive Mission|log|3203|0
units.english: The Kimek are large insectoid aliens, and are members of the Coalition. They discovered spaceflight after the Saryds, but before the Arachi. They are intensely social creatures, preferring to live together in massive buildings with thousands of inhabitants, and many of their worlds have populations in the tens of billions, far more than any human world.
units.italian: I Kimek sono grandi alieni insettoidi, e sono membri della Coalizione. Hanno scoperto il volo spaziale dopo i Saryd, ma prima degli Arachi. Sono creature intensamente sociali, che preferiscono vivere insieme in edifici enormi con migliaia di abitanti, e molti dei loro mondi hanno popolazioni nell'ordine delle decine di miliardi, molto più di qualsiasi mondo umano.

units.id: mission:Heliarchs Buy Jump Drive Mission|log|3204|0
units.english: The spider-like Arachi were the last of the three Coalition species to discover interstellar travel. Most members of their society owe allegiance to one of the great Arach "Houses," organizations that are somewhat similar to guilds and that each specialize in one particular form of industry or technology.
units.italian: Gli Arachi, simili a ragni, sono stati gli ultimi delle tre specie della Coalizione a scoprire il viaggio interstellare. La maggior parte dei membri della loro società deve fedeltà a una delle grandi "Case" Arach, organizzazioni in qualche modo simili a corporazioni, ciascuna specializzata in una particolare forma di industria o tecnologia.

units.id: mission:Heliarchs Buy Jump Drive Mission|	She thanks you yet again, salutes, and leaves to follow the entourage guarding the newly purchased jump drive. Not a minute after she has left, three more Heliarchs arrive at your ship, a delegation consisting of a member of each of the three Coalition species, all wearing golden circlets denoting their rank and authority. "A most unexpected, but greatly valued contribution this is," the Saryd says, "to think that so eager would our visitor be to prove their diligence and commitment."|3205|0
units.english: She thanks you yet again, salutes, and leaves to follow the entourage guarding the newly purchased jump drive. Not a minute after she has left, three more Heliarchs arrive at your ship, a delegation consisting of a member of each of the three Coalition species, all wearing golden circlets denoting their rank and authority. "A most unexpected, but greatly valued contribution this is," the Saryd says, "to think that so eager would our visitor be to prove their diligence and commitment."
units.italian: Ti ringrazia ancora una volta, fa il saluto, e parte per seguire il corteo che scorta il motore di salto appena comprato. Non passa un minuto da quando se n'è andata che altri tre Heliarchs arrivano alla tua nave, una delegazione composta da un membro di ciascuna delle tre specie della Coalizione, tutti con cerchietti dorati che indicano il loro rango e la loro autorità. "Un contributo davvero inatteso, ma molto prezioso, questo è," dice il Saryd, "pensare che così impaziente di dimostrare la propria diligenza e il proprio impegno, il nostro visitatore fosse."

units.id: mission:Heliarchs Buy Jump Drive Mission|	The Kimek says, "As aided you have our society in breaking free of the Quarg's cages, with our society's technology may you be trusted."|3206|0

units.italian: Il Kimek dice: "Dato che aiutato la nostra società a liberarsi dalle gabbie dei Quarg, voi lo avete, della tecnologia della nostra società potete fidarvi."

units.italian: "Ma," dice l'Arach, "come tutti i civili, persino i cittadini, a voi le nostre armi e le nostre navi da guerra ancora non possiamo venderle."

units.id: mission:Heliarchs Buy Jump Drive Mission|	"Thank you."|3209|0
units.english: "Thank you."
units.italian: "Grazie."

units.italian: "Perché non permettete ai civili di comprare armi o navi da guerra?"

And to place the needs of the Coalition over the ambitions of their own native species, each one committed is. No such discipline do civilians have, even you. But as a respectful guest you are, to maintain your weapons we shall allow."
units.italian: "Per amore della pace, è," dice il Saryd. "L'esercito Heliarch, ben addestrato a usare le armi solo per difesa e solo per giustizia, è. E a mettere i bisogni della Coalizione sopra le ambizioni della propria specie d'origine, ognuno di loro si è impegnato. Una tale disciplina, i civili non l'hanno, nemmeno voi. Ma dato che un ospite rispettoso voi siete, a mantenere le vostre armi permetteremo."

I make a little money off of the few people that buy them, but I never quite reach the five-digits. The first one was self-published. units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 1|	Over the course of a few seconds, Anna's optimistic smile sinks, and her eyes seem to dull. "You'll probably laugh, but, well... I have something of a... problem with them. I still remember when I was a little girl, my parents took me to Humanika during a vacation trip. It was my first time on a world so alien, so naturally, I wanted to explore. I wandered off from our tour group, and soon realized I was lost." She looks back at you momentarily, as if gauging how you're taking her tale. "There were so many hallways, twists and turns - I still cannot figure out how I ended up in that maze. It was a darker portion of the spaceport, and as I kept calling out for my parents, I only ever heard my own voice echoing back. And then, I saw it. A large Quarg, with eyes of a deep, piercing purple, staring right at me, far down the hallway. I broke into a sprint to flee, but I kept running into more and more Quarg... I don't remember much after that, just that I eventually got back to my parents.|3405|0
units.english: Over the course of a few seconds, Anna's optimistic smile sinks, and her eyes seem to dull. "You'll probably laugh, but, well... I have something of a... problem with them. I still remember when I was a little girl, my parents took me to Humanika during a vacation trip. It was my first time on a world so alien, so naturally, I wanted to explore. I wandered off from our tour group, and soon realized I was lost." She looks back at you momentarily, as if gauging how you're taking her tale. "There were so many hallways, twists and turns - I still cannot figure out how I ended up in that maze. It was a darker portion of the spaceport, and as I kept calling out for my parents, I only ever heard my own voice echoing back. And then, I saw it. A large Quarg, with eyes of a deep, piercing purple, staring right at me, far down the hallway. I broke into a sprint to flee, but I kept running into more and more Quarg... I don't remember much after that, just that I eventually got back to my parents.
units.italian: Nel giro di pochi secondi, il sorriso ottimista di Anna si spegne, e i suoi occhi sembrano opacizzarsi. "Probabilmente riderai, ma, beh... ho una specie di... problema con loro. Ricordo ancora quando ero bambina, i miei genitori mi portarono su Humanika durante una vacanza. Era la prima volta che stavo su un mondo così alieno, quindi naturalmente volevo esplorare. Mi allontanai dal nostro gruppo di turisti, e mi resi presto conto di essermi persa." Ti guarda di nuovo per un momento, come se stesse valutando come prendi il suo racconto. "C'erano così tanti corridoi, curve e svolte: ancora non riesco a capire come sia finita in quel labirinto. Era una parte più buia dello spazioporto, e mentre continuavo a chiamare i miei genitori, sentivo solo la mia voce che tornava indietro come eco. E poi, l'ho visto. Un Quarg enorme, con occhi di un viola profondo e penetrante, che mi fissava, in fondo al corridoio. Scattai in una corsa per fuggire, ma continuavo a incrociare sempre più Quarg... Non ricordo molto dopo quello, solo che alla fine tornai dai miei genitori.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 1|	"And then when I grew up, when I was a teenager, I decided to do a project on the Quarg for college, assisting a journalist writing an article on them. I tried to keep the memories of that episode in my childhood away, for the sake of the project, but as I interviewed them, as I tried to talk and befriend them... even the polite ones, they seemed so... aloof. Different - and not in a good way. I just felt a great unease being there, near them again. It certainly didn't help that they often responded with silence to my questions, as if they had something to hide. For months I tried, but they just would not budge, and that eerie feeling whenever one was with me never went away..."|3406|0
units.english: "And then when I grew up, when I was a teenager, I decided to do a project on the Quarg for college, assisting a journalist writing an article on them. I tried to keep the memories of that episode in my childhood away, for the sake of the project, but as I interviewed them, as I tried to talk and befriend them... even the polite ones, they seemed so... aloof. Different - and not in a good way. I just felt a great unease being there, near them again. It certainly didn't help that they often responded with silence to my questions, as if they had something to hide. For months I tried, but they just would not budge, and that eerie feeling whenever one was with me never went away..."
units.italian: "E poi, quando sono cresciuta, da adolescente, decisi di fare un progetto sui Quarg per l'università, aiutando una giornalista che scriveva un articolo su di loro. Cercai di tenere lontani i ricordi di quell'episodio dell'infanzia, per il bene del progetto, ma mentre li intervistavo, mentre cercavo di parlare e fare amicizia con loro... persino quelli gentili sembravano così... distanti. Diversi, e non in senso buono. Sentivo solo un grande disagio a stare lì, di nuovo vicino a loro. Di certo non aiutava che spesso rispondessero con il silenzio alle mie domande, come se avessero qualcosa da nascondere. Ci ho provato per mesi, ma non si smuovevano, e quella sensazione inquietante ogni volta che uno di loro era con me non se ne andava mai..."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 1|	"That must have been rough, stuck on Humanika. How did your parents eventually find you?"|3411|0
units.english: "That must have been rough, stuck on Humanika. How did your parents eventually find you?"
units.italian: "Dev'essere stato brutto, bloccata su Humanika. Come ti hanno ritrovata alla fine i tuoi genitori?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 1|	"Can I have a copy of the book?"|3413|0
units.english: "Can I have a copy of the book?"
units.italian: "Posso avere una copia del libro?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 1|	"Well that's all well and good. But I have my own business to attend to now. Good luck with your book, thanks for your time, and goodbye."|3416|0
units.english: "Well that's all well and good. But I have my own business to attend to now. Good luck with your book, thanks for your time, and goodbye."
units.italian: "Beh, tutto molto bello. Ma ora ho i miei affari a cui badare. Buona fortuna con il tuo libro, grazie del tempo, e arrivederci."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 1|	"I'm afraid I can't afford to give it away right now."|3420|0
units.english: "I'm afraid I can't afford to give it away right now."
units.italian: "Temo di non potermene permettere di regalarne una adesso."

They obliged, and we left that world; I've never wanted to go back."|3423|0
units.english: "I have no idea. But it was distressing being stuck with that Quarg for what felt like an eternity. I don't remember exactly how long. Eventually, another Quarg brought my parents to me. I told them I wanted to get off Humanika as fast as possible and get back to Zug. They obliged, and we left that world; I've never wanted to go back."
units.italian: "Non ne ho idea. Ma è stato angosciante restare bloccata con quel Quarg per quello che sembrava un'eternità. Non ricordo esattamente quanto. Alla fine, un altro Quarg ha portato i miei genitori da me. Ho detto loro che volevo andarmene da Humanika il prima possibile e tornare su Zug. Hanno acconsentito, e abbiamo lasciato quel mondo; non ci sono mai più voluta tornare."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 1|	"So you said your books don't sell well, right?"|3425|0
units.english: "So you said your books don't sell well, right?"
units.italian: "Quindi dicevi che i tuoi libri non vendono bene, giusto?"

units.italian: Mentre Anna cerca come può di mantenere la compostezza, i suoi lineamenti mostrano chiaramente che l'argomento la mette a disagio. "No, non vendono," dice alla fine. "Persino alcuni dei miei amici e familiari non hanno molto di buono da dire su di loro, e ancora meno sono disposti a fare qualcosa per me." I suoi occhi prendono una luce vagamente più ottimista. "Tu, per caso... lavori per qualche editore? Qualcuno interessato al mio lavoro?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 1|	(Tell her about the Coalition.)|3428|0

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 1|	"Will they really like my books?"|3433|0
units.english: "Will they really like my books?"
units.italian: "I miei libri piaceranno davvero?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 1|	"They will, hopefully."|3435|0
units.english: "They will, hopefully."
units.italian: "Speriamo di sì."

units.italian: "Beh, meglio provare che arrendersi."

units.english: "These stories might just inspire my next novel. But they wouldn't speak our language. How are they going to read my books?" You reply, "They have a translation device."
units.italian: "Queste storie potrebbero persino ispirare il mio prossimo romanzo. Ma loro non parlerebbero la nostra lingua. Come faranno a leggere i miei libri?" Rispondi: "Hanno un dispositivo di traduzione."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 1|	"That's reassuring... but, how am I even going to get there?" she queries.|3438|0
units.english: "That's reassuring... but, how am I even going to get there?" she queries.
units.italian: "Questo mi rincuora... ma, come ci arrivo?" chiede.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 1|	"I'll take you there."|3440|0
units.english: "I'll take you there."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 1|	"I don't think you can."|3441|0

units.italian: Il suo tono diventa molto più eccitato. "Devo pagare qualcosa? Aspetta solo un po'. Vado a casa a prendere quello che mi serve per il viaggio, e poi possiamo andare in questa... Coalizione," dice Anna.

units.english: After approximately an hour of waiting, Anna appears outside of your ship, knocking on the hatch. You open it to let her inside and prepare to leave the spaceport.
units.italian: Dopo circa un'ora di attesa, Anna compare fuori dalla tua nave e bussa al portello. Glielo apri per farla entrare e ti prepari a lasciare lo spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 1|	Filled with disappointment, Anna says, "Well, I'm afraid I have other things to do, then. Thank you for the stories, at least." She leaves.|3448|0
units.english: Filled with disappointment, Anna says, "Well, I'm afraid I have other things to do, then. Thank you for the stories, at least." She leaves.
units.italian: Piena di delusione, Anna dice: "Beh, temo di avere altro da fare, allora. Almeno grazie per le storie." Se ne va.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 1|	"I'm afraid I can't afford to give one away right now, but I'm happy to show it to you. units.english: "I'm afraid I can't afford to give one away right now, but I'm happy to show it to you. I assume you already know that it's the story of a group of humans who steal the Quarg's jumping technology and see what's truly beyond the hyperlanes we've known for so long."
units.italian: "Temo di non poterne regalare una adesso, ma sarò felice di mostrartela. Immagino che tu sappia già che è la storia di un gruppo di umani che ruba la tecnologia di salto dei Quarg e vede cosa c'è davvero oltre le ipervie che conosciamo da tanto tempo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 1|As the flames of your jump drive fade away, Anna comes out of her bunk in shock. "What was that? It felt like the whole ship vanished out of our space altogether! Where are we?"|3463|0
units.english: As the flames of your jump drive fade away, Anna comes out of her bunk in shock. "What was that? It felt like the whole ship vanished out of our space altogether! Where are we?"
units.italian: Mentre le fiamme del tuo motore di salto si spengono, Anna esce dalla cuccetta scioccata. "Che cos'era? Sembrava che l'intera nave svanisse dal nostro spazio! Dove siamo?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 1|	"My jump drive would like to welcome you to Coalition space."|3465|0
units.english: "My jump drive would like to welcome you to Coalition space."
units.italian: "Il mio motore di salto vuole darti il benvenuto nello spazio della Coalizione."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 1|	"That was a jump drive."|3466|0
units.english: "That was a jump drive."
units.italian: "Quello era un motore di salto."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 1|	"That's what happens every time I go to Coalition space with a jump drive."|3467|0
units.english: "That's what happens every time I go to Coalition space with a jump drive."
units.italian: "Succede ogni volta che vado nello spazio della Coalizione con un motore di salto."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 1|	"Wow. I can't believe this is happening!" Anna looks out the window, then turns back.|3468|0
units.english: "Wow. I can't believe this is happening!" Anna looks out the window, then turns back.
units.italian: "Wow. Non ci credo che stia succedendo!" Anna guarda fuori dal finestrino, poi si volta.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 1|	"Can I take a look at your jump drive? I'm interested to see how it works," Anna says. You take her to the engine room of the <ship>, where she begins taking notes and pictures of the drive.|3469|0
units.english: "Can I take a look at your jump drive? I'm interested to see how it works," Anna says. You take her to the engine room of the <ship>, where she begins taking notes and pictures of the drive.
units.italian: "Posso dare un'occhiata al tuo motore di salto? Mi interessa vedere come funziona," dice Anna. La porti nella sala macchine della <ship>, dove comincia a prendere appunti e foto del motore.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 1|	"Well, thank you for bringing me here," Anna says when she finishes. "I didn't sleep too well, so I'll see you later. Goodbye!" She heads back into her cabin, and you settle back into the controls.|3470|0
units.english: "Well, thank you for bringing me here," Anna says when she finishes. "I didn't sleep too well, so I'll see you later. Goodbye!" She heads back into her cabin, and you settle back into the controls.
units.italian: "Beh, grazie per avermi portato qui," dice Anna quando ha finito. "Non ho dormito granché, quindi ci vediamo dopo. Ciao!" Torna nella sua cabina, e tu ti rimetti ai comandi.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 1|	"Greetings, <first> <last>. This other human you have brought, who she is, may I ask you?"|3475|0

units.italian: "Salve, <first> <last>. Quest'altra umana che avete portato, chi sia, posso chiedervi?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 1|	"Oh, I write science fiction novels," replies Anna, only mildly taken aback by the sight of giant beetles.|3476|0

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 1|	Then, switching the translation box back on, the Kimek explains that Anna is welcome to be with you, but reminds you that she will not be allowed to do much until she registers with the Heliarchs on the Ring of Friendship.|3478|0
