units.english: After receiving the book - it turns out to have gotten there in a normal spacecraft, along with a message from Anna stating her disappointment - you get in contact with Kachachee and inform them you have a copy of "Beyond the Hyperdrive." They respond, telling you to meet them at a public square within the spaceport.
units.italian: Dopo aver ricevuto il libro (a quanto pare è arrivato con una normale navicella, insieme a un messaggio di Anna che esprime la sua delusione), ti metti in contatto con Kachachee e gli dici che hai una copia di "Oltre l'Iperguida". Rispondono dicendoti di incontrarli in una piazza pubblica dentro lo spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Book Discovered 2|When you land on <planet>, you get in contact with Kachachee and inform them you have a copy of "Beyond the Hyperdrive." They respond, telling you to meet them at a public square within the spaceport.|3511|0
units.english: When you land on <planet>, you get in contact with Kachachee and inform them you have a copy of "Beyond the Hyperdrive." They respond, telling you to meet them at a public square within the spaceport.
units.italian: Quando atterri su <planet>, ti metti in contatto con Kachachee e gli dici che hai una copia di "Oltre l'Iperguida". Rispondono dicendoti di incontrarli in una piazza pubblica dentro lo spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Book Discovered 2|	Walking over to the aforementioned public square, you recognize Kachachee among the crowd. You hold up your copy of Beyond the Hyperdrive and hand it over to them. Kachachee eagerly takes the copy. "Very thankful we are, for this book. Read it with my group, I must. But for your troubles, worthy of <payment>, you are." They then give you a chip and walk away, blending back into the crowd.|3513|0
units.english: Walking over to the aforementioned public square, you recognize Kachachee among the crowd. You hold up your copy of Beyond the Hyperdrive and hand it over to them. Kachachee eagerly takes the copy. "Very thankful we are, for this book. Read it with my group, I must. But for your troubles, worthy of <payment>, you are." They then give you a chip and walk away, blending back into the crowd.
units.italian: Camminando verso la summenzionata piazza pubblica, riconosci Kachachee tra la folla. Alzi la tua copia di Oltre l'Iperguida e gliela consegni. Kachachee prende la copia con impazienza. "Molto grati siamo, per questo libro. Leggerlo con il mio gruppo, io devo. Ma per il disturbo, degno di <payment>, voi siete." Ti danno poi un chip e si allontanano, fondendosi di nuovo nella folla.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 2|name|3516|0
units.english: Help Anna register with the Heliarchy
units.italian: Aiuta Anna a registrarsi presso l'Heliarchia

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 2|description|3517|0
units.english: Take Anna Fangvin to the <destination> so she can register with the Heliarchs.
units.italian: Porta Anna Fangvin sul <destination> così che possa registrarsi presso gli Heliarchs.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 2|You walk through the spaceport, looking for Anna. You find her in the middle of a public square, seated at a table with her laptop out. You figure she must've intended on getting started on some early work, what with the newly found inspiration of being in such an alien society, but it seems the sheer volume and diversity of peoples here on <origin> made her forget to type entirely.|3525|0
units.english: You walk through the spaceport, looking for Anna. You find her in the middle of a public square, seated at a table with her laptop out. You figure she must've intended on getting started on some early work, what with the newly found inspiration of being in such an alien society, but it seems the sheer volume and diversity of peoples here on <origin> made her forget to type entirely.
units.italian: Attraversi lo spazioporto cercando Anna. La trovi in mezzo a una piazza pubblica, seduta a un tavolo con il portatile aperto. Immagini che volesse cominciare qualche lavoro preliminare, con la nuova ispirazione di trovarsi in una società così aliena, ma sembra che il puro numero e la varietà di popoli qui su <origin> le abbiano fatto dimenticare del tutto di scrivere.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 2|	She only seems to notice you when you also sit down beside her. "Oh, hello again, <first>!" she says, snapping back into focus. "Is the ship ready?"|3526|0
units.english: She only seems to notice you when you also sit down beside her. "Oh, hello again, <first>!" she says, snapping back into focus. "Is the ship ready?"
units.italian: Sembra notarti solo quando ti siedi anche tu accanto a lei. "Oh, ciao di nuovo, <first>!" dice, tornando di colpo presente. "La nave è pronta?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 2|	Hearing an affirmative answer, Anna stands up from her chair and begins following you to the <ship>. She settles into her bunk as you prepare for the trip to the <destination>.|3527|0
units.english: Hearing an affirmative answer, Anna stands up from her chair and begins following you to the <ship>. She settles into her bunk as you prepare for the trip to the <destination>.
units.italian: Sentendo una risposta affermativa, Anna si alza dalla sedia e comincia a seguirti verso la <ship>. Si sistema nella cuccetta mentre ti prepari al viaggio verso la <destination>.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 2|As you enter <system>, Anna walks out of her bunk and finds a spot on the side of the bridge, peering into the empty void. "What a massive ringworld!" she exclaims.|3531|0
units.english: As you enter <system>, Anna walks out of her bunk and finds a spot on the side of the bridge, peering into the empty void. "What a massive ringworld!" she exclaims.
units.italian: Mentre entri in <system>, Anna esce dalla cuccetta e trova un posto sul lato della plancia, scrutando il vuoto. "Che mondo ad anello enorme!" esclama.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 2|	"It's enormous. They stole it from the Quarg roughly seven thousand years ago."|3533|0
units.english: "It's enormous. They stole it from the Quarg roughly seven thousand years ago."
units.italian: "È immenso. L'hanno rubato ai Quarg circa settemila anni fa."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 2|	(Say nothing.)|3534|0
units.english: (Say nothing.)
units.italian: (Non dire nulla.)

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 2|	"This is going to be a great source of inspiration for my next novel," says Anna, still in awe. She pulls out a small notebook and begins busily writing in it.|3535|0
units.english: "This is going to be a great source of inspiration for my next novel," says Anna, still in awe. She pulls out a small notebook and begins busily writing in it.
units.italian: "Sarà un'ottima fonte di ispirazione per il mio prossimo romanzo," dice Anna, ancora sbalordita. Tira fuori un quadernetto e comincia a scriverci in fretta.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 2|Anna is amazed as you touch down on the ringworld. As the two of you open the hatch, you see a Heliarch agent in front of you.|3538|0
units.english: Anna is amazed as you touch down on the ringworld. As the two of you open the hatch, you see a Heliarch agent in front of you.
units.italian: Anna resta meravigliata quando atterrate sul mondo ad anello. Mentre aprite il portello, vedete davanti a voi un agente Heliarch.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 2|	"Greetings, humans. For you, what can I do today?" asks the Heliarch. You respond that you would like to register Anna with the Heliarchy. Upon reaching the registration office, Anna enters, and fifteen minutes later exits alongside another Heliarch, this time a crowned Saryd. "They finally got all the paperwork done. We're off to the spaceport to get some food. Meet us there to discuss our next move."|3539|0
units.english: "Greetings, humans. For you, what can I do today?" asks the Heliarch. You respond that you would like to register Anna with the Heliarchy. Upon reaching the registration office, Anna enters, and fifteen minutes later exits alongside another Heliarch, this time a crowned Saryd. "They finally got all the paperwork done. We're off to the spaceport to get some food. Meet us there to discuss our next move."
units.italian: "Salve, umani. Per voi, cosa posso fare oggi?" chiede l'Heliarch. Rispondi che vorresti registrare Anna presso l'Heliarchia. Una volta arrivati all'ufficio di registrazione, Anna entra, e quindici minuti dopo esce insieme a un altro Heliarch, questa volta un Saryd con una corona. "Finalmente hanno finito tutta la carta. Andiamo allo spazioporto a mangiare qualcosa. Raggiungici lì per decidere il prossimo passo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 3|name|3543|0
units.english: Back to <planet>
units.italian: Ritorno su <planet>

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 3|description|3544|0
units.english: Now that Anna Fangvin has completed the registration process, take her and the Heliarch agent to get a translation device on <destination>.
units.italian: Ora che Anna Fangvin ha completato la registrazione, portala con l'agente Heliarch a prendere un dispositivo di traduzione su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 3|blocked|3548|0
units.english: You do not have enough space for Anna and the Heliarch agent. Return here when you have two bunks free.
units.italian: Non hai abbastanza spazio per Anna e l'agente Heliarch. Torna qui quando avrai due cuccette libere.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 3|Going through the spaceport looking for Anna, you finally find her at a restaurant, eating a longcow steak and typing something on her laptop. The Heliarch Saryd from earlier stands beside her, bent-over and gesturing at something on the screen. She sees you and motions for you to take a seat.|3553|0
units.english: Going through the spaceport looking for Anna, you finally find her at a restaurant, eating a longcow steak and typing something on her laptop. The Heliarch Saryd from earlier stands beside her, bent-over and gesturing at something on the screen. She sees you and motions for you to take a seat.
units.italian: Attraversando lo spazioporto in cerca di Anna, la trovi finalmente in un ristorante, che mangia una bistecca di longcow e scrive qualcosa sul portatile. L'Heliarch Saryd di prima le sta accanto, piegato in avanti e indicando qualcosa sullo schermo. Ti vede e ti fa cenno di sederti.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 3|	"This meat is so delicious! After months of instant noodles and takeout back home, it finally feels good to eat something that's actually healthy," she exclaims, closing the computer.|3554|0
units.english: "This meat is so delicious! After months of instant noodles and takeout back home, it finally feels good to eat something that's actually healthy," she exclaims, closing the computer.
units.italian: "Questa carne è deliziosa! Dopo mesi di noodles istantanei e cibo da asporto a casa, finalmente è bello mangiare qualcosa che fa davvero bene," esclama, chiudendo il computer.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 3|	"How good is it?"|3556|0
units.english: "How good is it?"
units.italian: "Quanto è buona?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 3|	"You ate nothing but that!?"|3558|0
units.english: "You ate nothing but that!?"
units.italian: "Non hai mangiato altro che quello!?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 3|	"My diet wasn't exactly the best. All I had was carbs and takeout food; I never could find time in my schedule to cook at home. I was working hard on Beyond the Hyperdrive at the time. This food is better than anything I could ever find on Zug.|3559|0
units.english: "My diet wasn't exactly the best. All I had was carbs and takeout food; I never could find time in my schedule to cook at home. I was working hard on Beyond the Hyperdrive at the time. This food is better than anything I could ever find on Zug.
units.italian: "La mia dieta non era esattamente delle migliori. Mangiavo solo carboidrati e cibo da asporto; non trovavo mai il tempo di cucinare a casa. All'epoca lavoravo sodo a Oltre l'Iperguida. Questo cibo è meglio di qualsiasi cosa potessi trovare su Zug.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 3|	"It's very good. Probably better than anything I've had back on Zug. Now, I'd like to get my book published here."|3562|0
units.english: "It's very good. Probably better than anything I've had back on Zug. Now, I'd like to get my book published here."
units.italian: "È molto buona. Probabilmente meglio di qualsiasi cosa abbia mangiato su Zug. Ora, vorrei riuscire a pubblicare il mio libro qui."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 3|	"On another note, I want to get my book published here."|3565|0
units.english: "On another note, I want to get my book published here."
units.italian: "A proposito, vorrei riuscire a pubblicare il mio libro qui."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 3|	"Have you found a publishing company yet?" you ask.|3567|0
units.english: "Have you found a publishing company yet?" you ask.
units.italian: "Hai già trovato una casa editrice?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 3|	"No," Anna replies. "But this Heliarch, Temporo, has been a huge help in finding a suitable publisher. Without them, it would've been nearly impossible for me to communicate with the restaurant staff, since they don't have a translation box."|3568|0
units.english: "No," Anna replies. "But this Heliarch, Temporo, has been a huge help in finding a suitable publisher. Without them, it would've been nearly impossible for me to communicate with the restaurant staff, since they don't have a translation box."
units.italian: "No," risponde Anna. "Ma questo Heliarch, Temporo, è stato di grande aiuto nel trovare un editore adatto. Senza di lui, mi sarebbe stato quasi impossibile comunicare con il personale del ristorante, dato che non hanno una scatola di traduzione."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 3|	"What's the plan now?"|3570|0
units.english: "What's the plan now?"
units.italian: "Qual è il piano adesso?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 3|	"Did the Heliarch agent mention anywhere we should go now?"|3571|0
units.english: "Did the Heliarch agent mention anywhere we should go now?"
units.italian: "L'agente Heliarch ha detto dove dovremmo andare adesso?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 3|	"Why does the Heliarchy care about who publishes the book?"|3572|0
units.english: "Why does the Heliarchy care about who publishes the book?"
units.italian: "Perché all'Heliarchia interessa chi pubblica il libro?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 3|label|3574|0
units.english: take us to destination
units.italian: take us to destination

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 3|	The Heliarch straightens up. "Take us to <planet>, you should. Better help there, I can."|3575|0
units.english: The Heliarch straightens up. "Take us to <planet>, you should. Better help there, I can."
units.italian: L'Heliarch si raddrizza. "Portarci su <planet>, voi dovreste. Un aiuto migliore lì, io posso dare."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 3|	"Does that sound reasonable to you?" Anna asks. When you reply in the affirmative, she says, "We'll be at your spaceship when you are."|3576|0
units.english: "Does that sound reasonable to you?" Anna asks. When you reply in the affirmative, she says, "We'll be at your spaceship when you are."
units.italian: "Ti sembra ragionevole?" chiede Anna. Quando rispondi di sì, dice: "Saremo alla tua nave quando ci sarai anche tu."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 3|	"I think Temporo was just trying to be helpful. He hasn't said anything to the contrary."|3579|0
units.english: "I think Temporo was just trying to be helpful. He hasn't said anything to the contrary."
units.italian: "Penso che Temporo stesse solo cercando di essere utile. Non ha detto nulla in contrario."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 3|As you land, Anna says, "Should we see about getting a translation device? I don't want to bother Temporo the whole time I'm here."|3583|0
units.english: As you land, Anna says, "Should we see about getting a translation device? I don't want to bother Temporo the whole time I'm here."
units.italian: Mentre atterrate, Anna dice: "Dovremmo vedere di procurarci un dispositivo di traduzione? Non voglio disturbare Temporo per tutto il tempo che sono qui."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 3|	Temporo approaches. "Trust you with a translator, the government cannot. So help you, I must. When found a publisher, you have, accompany you to their offices, I will."|3584|0
units.english: Temporo approaches. "Trust you with a translator, the government cannot. So help you, I must. When found a publisher, you have, accompany you to their offices, I will."
units.italian: Temporo si avvicina. "Affidarvi un traduttore, il governo non può. Quindi aiutarvi, io devo. Quando trovato un editore, voi l'avrete, accompagnarvi ai loro uffici, io lo farò."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 3|	"We need to find a publishing company then!" says Anna.|3585|0
units.english: "We need to find a publishing company then!" says Anna.
units.italian: "Allora dobbiamo trovare una casa editrice!" dice Anna.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 3|	"The Kimek might be a good choice. They have a high population."|3588|0
units.english: "The Kimek might be a good choice. They have a high population."
units.italian: "I Kimek potrebbero essere una buona scelta. Hanno una popolazione numerosa."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 3|	"Perhaps the Saryd. They're more culturally similar to humans, so they may be more interested in human books."|3590|0
units.english: "Perhaps the Saryd. They're more culturally similar to humans, so they may be more interested in human books."
units.italian: "Forse i Saryd. Sono culturalmente più simili agli umani, quindi potrebbero essere più interessati ai libri umani."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 3|	"The Arachi have a close-knit population. Word of a new book might spread quickly there."|3594|0
units.english: "The Arachi have a close-knit population. Word of a new book might spread quickly there."
units.italian: "Gli Arachi hanno una popolazione molto unita. La voce di un nuovo libro potrebbe diffondersi in fretta lì."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 3|	"Oh, it's kind of embarrassing but... I'm actually a bit afraid of spiders, so I'm going to take a while to get used to the Arachi."|3599|0
units.english: "Oh, it's kind of embarrassing but... I'm actually a bit afraid of spiders, so I'm going to take a while to get used to the Arachi."
units.italian: "Oh, è un po' imbarazzante ma... in realtà ho un po' paura dei ragni, quindi mi servirà un po' di tempo per abituarmi agli Arachi."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 3|	"I thought the same at first, but from what I've seen the Saryds seem pretty reserved, don't you think? Maybe another species would be better."|3604|0
units.english: "I thought the same at first, but from what I've seen the Saryds seem pretty reserved, don't you think? Maybe another species would be better."
units.italian: "Pensavo lo stesso anch'io all'inizio, ma da quello che ho visto i Saryd sembrano piuttosto riservati, non trovi? Magari un'altra specie sarebbe meglio."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 3|	"But where can we find a Kimek publishing company? We haven't even translated our book into their language yet!"|3610|0
units.english: "But where can we find a Kimek publishing company? We haven't even translated our book into their language yet!"
units.italian: "Ma dove troviamo una casa editrice Kimek? Non abbiamo nemmeno tradotto il nostro libro nella loro lingua!"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 3|	"We'll find a company."|3612|0
units.english: "We'll find a company."
units.italian: "Troveremo una casa editrice."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 3|	"Given the number of books here, there has to be a publishing company somewhere."|3613|0
units.english: "Given the number of books here, there has to be a publishing company somewhere."
units.italian: "Visto il numero di libri che ci sono qui, da qualche parte una casa editrice deve esserci."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 3|	"The faster we can get the book published, the better. Meet me in the spaceport in a few hours; I'll find a good company."|3614|0
units.english: "The faster we can get the book published, the better. Meet me in the spaceport in a few hours; I'll find a good company."
units.italian: "Prima riusciamo a pubblicare il libro, meglio è. Ci vediamo allo spazioporto tra qualche ora; troverò una buona casa editrice."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 3|	Before Anna can head off, Temporo rises. "Again accompany you, I will."|3615|0
units.english: Before Anna can head off, Temporo rises. "Again accompany you, I will."
units.italian: Prima che Anna possa andarsene, Temporo si alza. "Di nuovo accompagnarvi, io lo farò."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 4|name|3619|0
units.english: Kimek Publishing Company
units.italian: Casa editrice Kimek

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 4|description|3620|0
units.english: Anna Fangvin found a Kimek publishing company who is willing to get her book published. Bring her to <destination>.
units.italian: Anna Fangvin ha trovato una casa editrice Kimek disposta a pubblicare il suo libro. Portala su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 4|blocked|3623|0
units.english: You do not have enough bunk space for Anna Fangvin and the Heliarch agent. Come back here when you have two bunks free.
units.italian: Non hai abbastanza cuccette per Anna Fangvin e l'agente Heliarch. Torna qui quando avrai due cuccette libere.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 4|The spaceport of Ki Patek Ka is vast, and would normally prove a nightmarish place to look for just one person. Thankfully, Anna being the only other human within the Coalition makes your search relatively quick. She has chosen to settle in a cafeteria with her laptop, typing away at the keyboard, presumably writing a short story to post.|3629|0
units.english: The spaceport of Ki Patek Ka is vast, and would normally prove a nightmarish place to look for just one person. Thankfully, Anna being the only other human within the Coalition makes your search relatively quick. She has chosen to settle in a cafeteria with her laptop, typing away at the keyboard, presumably writing a short story to post.
units.italian: Lo spazioporto di Ki Patek Ka è immenso, e normalmente sarebbe un posto da incubo dove cercare una sola persona. Per fortuna, dato che Anna è l'unica altra umana nella Coalizione, la ricerca è relativamente rapida. Si è sistemata in una caffetteria con il portatile, che scrive sulla tastiera, presumibilmente un racconto breve da pubblicare.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 4|	"<first>! I found a company who's willing to publish me! I sent them a digital copy of my book and they instructed me to visit their office on <planet>," explains Anna, once again enthusiastic. At a table behind her you notice the figure of Temporo, speaking to a waiter.|3630|0
units.english: "<first>! I found a company who's willing to publish me! I sent them a digital copy of my book and they instructed me to visit their office on <planet>," explains Anna, once again enthusiastic. At a table behind her you notice the figure of Temporo, speaking to a waiter.
units.italian: "<first>! Ho trovato una casa editrice disposta a pubblicarmi! Gli ho mandato una copia digitale del libro e mi hanno detto di andare nel loro ufficio su <planet>," spiega Anna, di nuovo entusiasta. A un tavolo dietro di lei noti la figura di Temporo, che parla con un cameriere.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 4|	"Great!"|3632|0
units.english: "Great!"
units.italian: "Fantastico!"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 4|	"Let's go!"|3634|0
units.english: "Let's go!"
units.italian: "Andiamo!"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 4|	"What's the publishing company called?"|3636|0
units.english: "What's the publishing company called?"
units.italian: "Come si chiama la casa editrice?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 4|	"They're called 'Priyepichia Publishing.'" Anna shows you beautiful pictures of a clean white building perched on a mountainside, high above gentle waves. On the roof stands a landing pad painted with a striped, sleek beetle-like creature whose hind legs resemble broad paddles.|3637|0
units.english: "They're called 'Priyepichia Publishing.'" Anna shows you beautiful pictures of a clean white building perched on a mountainside, high above gentle waves. On the roof stands a landing pad painted with a striped, sleek beetle-like creature whose hind legs resemble broad paddles.
units.italian: "Si chiama 'Priyepichia Publishing'." Anna ti mostra belle immagini di un edificio bianco e pulito appollaiato su un versante montuoso, molto sopra onde gentili. Sul tetto c'è una piattaforma di atterraggio dipinta con una creatura snella a strisce simile a uno scarafaggio, le cui zampe posteriori somigliano a larghe pagaie.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 4|	You head back to your ship with Anna and Temporo, and plot a course to <destination>.|3639|0
units.english: You head back to your ship with Anna and Temporo, and plot a course to <destination>.
units.italian: Torni alla nave con Anna e Temporo, e tracci la rotta per <destination>.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 4|Landing on <planet>, Anna is excitedly holding a copy of 'Beyond the Hyperdrive.' She hastily opens the hatch as soon as it unlocks.|3644|0
units.english: Landing on <planet>, Anna is excitedly holding a copy of 'Beyond the Hyperdrive.' She hastily opens the hatch as soon as it unlocks.
units.italian: Atterrando su <planet>, Anna stringe con eccitazione una copia di 'Oltre l'Iperguida'. Apre in fretta il portello appena si sblocca.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 4|	Anna stops, waiting for you to catch up. "In the message they sent me, they included instructions on how to reach their offices," she explains. "Let's go!"|3645|0
units.english: Anna stops, waiting for you to catch up. "In the message they sent me, they included instructions on how to reach their offices," she explains. "Let's go!"
units.italian: Anna si ferma, aspettando che la raggiungi. "Nel messaggio che mi hanno mandato, hanno incluso le istruzioni per arrivare ai loro uffici," spiega. "Andiamo!"

units.italian: "Si chiama 'Oltre l'Iperguida'. Penso che probabilmente sarà uno dei migliori libri di tutti i tempi."

units.italian: "Mi hanno detto che a causa del processo di revisione per assicurarsi che sia adatto, dovrò aspettare circa sei mesi. Per fortuna mi hanno sistemato un piccolo appartamento dove vivere. Ora puoi andare, ma se vuoi tornare nello spazio umano, ricordati di tornare a incontrarmi qui."

units.italian: "Farò in modo di farlo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 4|	"Thanks again, <first> <last>. I'll forever be grateful to you for helping me. I never thought I'd be successful as an author, but when I met you, you helped me turn my career into something I thought I'd never see."|3753|0

units.italian: "Grazie ancora, <first> <last>. Ti sarò eternamente grata per avermi aiutata. Non avrei mai pensato di riuscire come autrice, ma quando ti ho incontrato mi hai aiutata a trasformare la mia carriera in qualcosa che pensavo di non vedere mai."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 4|	"Just helping out."|3755|0

units.italian: "Dovevo solo dare una mano."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 4|	"I'm happy to have helped you."|3756|0

units.italian: "Sono felice di averti aiutata."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 4|	"Again, thank you for all your help."|3757|0
units.english: "Again, thank you for all your help."
units.italian: "Grazie ancora per tutto il tuo aiuto."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 4|	You return to the spaceport the way you came and return to your ship.|3758|0

units.italian: Torni allo spazioporto per la strada da cui sei venuto e torni alla nave.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 4|	"I need to stay here so I can answer their questions during the review process. Don't worry about me."|3761|0

units.italian: "Devo restare qui così posso rispondere alle loro domande durante il processo di revisione. Non preoccuparti per me."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Struggling Author 4|	"Got it. Good luck publishing your book."|3763|0

units.italian: "Capito. Buona fortuna con la pubblicazione del libro."

units.english: Anna was a struggling science fiction author in human space until she found success publishing her novel Beyond the Hyperdrive in the Coalition. Her book is a bestseller in the Kimek region.
units.italian: Anna era un'autrice di fantascienza in difficoltà nello spazio umano finché non ha trovato il successo pubblicando il suo romanzo Oltre l'Iperguida nella Coalizione. Il suo libro è un bestseller nella regione Kimek.

units.id: conversation:anna invites you to book signing|log|3820|0
units.context: conversation:anna invites you to book signing
units.english: Helped somebody named Anna Fangvin get her book published in Coalition space. Apparently, it's a bestseller now. The book was Beyond the Hyperdrive, something about humans stealing jump drives from the Quarg.
units.italian: Ho aiutato una certa Anna Fangvin a pubblicare il suo libro nello spazio della Coalizione. A quanto pare, ora è un bestseller. Il libro era Oltre l'Iperguida, qualcosa su umani che rubano motori di salto ai Quarg.

units.id: conversation:anna invites you to book signing|The moment you land, Anna arrives, very happy to see you. She grabs your shoulders with both arms and in an excited tone explains that her book has been approved for publication.|3824|0

units.english: The moment you land, Anna arrives, very happy to see you. She grabs your shoulders with both arms and in an excited tone explains that her book has been approved for publication.
units.italian: Appena atterri, Anna arriva, molto felice di vederti. Ti afferra le spalle con entrambe le braccia e in tono eccitato spiega che il suo libro è stato approvato per la pubblicazione.

units.id: conversation:anna invites you to book signing|	"They're publishing Beyond the Hyperdrive today, and there's a full release event where I'll be signing copies! Thanks for everything you've done, <first>! Do you want to join me during the book signing?"|3825|0
units.context: conversation:anna invites you to book signing
units.english: "They're publishing Beyond the Hyperdrive today, and there's a full release event where I'll be signing copies! Thanks for everything you've done, <first>! Do you want to join me during the book signing?"
units.italian: "Oggi pubblicano Oltre l'Iperguida, e c'è un evento di lancio completo dove firmerò le copie! Grazie di tutto, <first>! Vuoi venire con me durante la firmacopie?"

units.context: conversation:anna invites you to book signing
units.english: "I've been with you through the whole process. Count me in!"
units.italian: "Ti ho seguita per tutto il processo. Ci sto!"

units.context: conversation:anna invites you to book signing

units.italian: "Ne sarei felice!"

units.italian: "No, grazie."

units.italian: "Ottimo! Andiamo alla libreria a prepararci! Il personale ha già preparato i posti per entrambi."

units.italian: Tu e Anna entrate nella grande libreria dello spazioporto. Ci sono già diversi Heliarchs, con i loro Bastoni Antisommossa Enforcer in posizione per controllare la folla.

units.context: conversation:anna invites you to book signing
units.english: A Kimek, dressed in what looks like the bookstore's uniform, takes out a loudspeaker with multiple handholds and begins announcing the release of Beyond the Hyperdrive. Within minutes, the bookstore has become crowded, with a long queue forming between the cashiers and your table, as Anna signs every copy brought to her.
units.italian: Un Kimek, vestito con quella che sembra l'uniforme della libreria, tira fuori un megafono con più impugnature e comincia ad annunciare l'uscita di Oltre l'Iperguida. Nel giro di pochi minuti, la libreria si riempie, con una lunga coda che si forma tra le casse e il vostro tavolo, mentre Anna firma ogni copia che le viene portata.

units.id: conversation:anna invites you to book signing|	Occasionally, Anna alternates between her left and right hand to sign books whenever the other is tired. For hours, this continues. You tried to keep count of how many copies she signed, but gave up when it reached six hundred.|3834|0
units.context: conversation:anna invites you to book signing
units.english: Occasionally, Anna alternates between her left and right hand to sign books whenever the other is tired. For hours, this continues. You tried to keep count of how many copies she signed, but gave up when it reached six hundred.
units.italian: Ogni tanto, Anna alterna la mano sinistra e la destra per firmare i libri quando l'altra è stanca. Per ore va avanti così. Hai provato a tenere il conto di quante copie ha firmato, ma hai rinunciato quando è arrivato a seicento.

units.id: conversation:anna invites you to book signing|	(Say nothing.)|3836|0
units.context: conversation:anna invites you to book signing
units.english: (Say nothing.)
units.italian: (Non dire nulla.)

units.english: "Are you left- or right-handed?"
units.italian: "Sei mancina o destrorsa?"

units.id: conversation:anna invites you to book signing|	"I was originally born left-handed, but as a child I chose to learn how to use my right hand, because I thought being able to use both hands would be cool."|3839|0
units.context: conversation:anna invites you to book signing
units.english: "I was originally born left-handed, but as a child I chose to learn how to use my right hand, because I thought being able to use both hands would be cool."
units.italian: "Originariamente sono nata mancina, ma da bambina ho scelto di imparare a usare la mano destra, perché pensavo che saper usare entrambe le mani sarebbe stato forte."

units.italian: La firmacopie continua per diverse altre ore. Alla fine, lo stesso Kimek in uniforme della libreria annuncia che il negozio sta per chiudere.

units.id: conversation:anna invites you to book signing|	As the store closes and the queue shortens, Anna signs the last Kimek's copy. With that, the event is over. Anna walks with you back to your ship to say goodbye.|3842|0
units.context: conversation:anna invites you to book signing
units.english: As the store closes and the queue shortens, Anna signs the last Kimek's copy. With that, the event is over. Anna walks with you back to your ship to say goodbye.
units.italian: Mentre il negozio chiude e la coda si accorcia, Anna firma la copia dell'ultimo Kimek. Con questo, l'evento è finito. Anna torna con te alla nave per salutarti.

units.id: conversation:anna invites you to book signing|	"My book succeeded beyond my wildest dreams, and it was all because of you, <first>!" she says, almost in a teary voice. She pulls out a credit chip. "Here, <payment>. You've done so much for me and my career, and you deserve it."|3843|0
units.context: conversation:anna invites you to book signing
units.english: "My book succeeded beyond my wildest dreams, and it was all because of you, <first>!" she says, almost in a teary voice. She pulls out a credit chip. "Here, <payment>. You've done so much for me and my career, and you deserve it."
units.italian: "Il mio libro ha avuto un successo oltre i miei sogni più sfrenati, ed è tutto merito tuo, <first>!" dice, quasi con voce in lacrime. Tira fuori un chip di crediti. "Ecco, <payment>. Hai fatto tanto per me e per la mia carriera, e te lo meriti."

units.id: conversation:anna invites you to book signing|	Anna then takes out another copy of Beyond the Hyperdrive, which she signs in front of you. units.context: conversation:anna invites you to book signing
units.english: Anna then takes out another copy of Beyond the Hyperdrive, which she signs in front of you. It is the Coalition edition of the book, but translated to your language. A special copy just for you, as a thank you for all you've done."
units.italian: Anna tira poi fuori un'altra copia di Oltre l'Iperguida, che firma davanti a te. È l'edizione della Coalizione del libro, ma tradotta nella tua lingua. Sfogliandola in fretta, ti rendi conto che il libro è stato modificato in modo significativo rispetto alla versione che avevi letto nello spazio umano. "Ecco, prendila. Una copia speciale solo per te, come ringraziamento per tutto quello che hai fatto."

units.id: conversation:anna invites you to book signing|	"Why is this book so different from the one in human space?"|3846|0
units.context: conversation:anna invites you to book signing
units.english: "Why is this book so different from the one in human space?"
units.italian: "Perché questo libro è così diverso da quello nello spazio umano?"

units.id: conversation:anna invites you to book signing|	"Did you make any changes to it?"|3847|0
units.context: conversation:anna invites you to book signing
units.english: "Did you make any changes to it?"
units.italian: "Ci hai fatto qualche modifica?"

units.id: conversation:anna invites you to book signing|	"Well, for one, it's not in our language. Some concepts just don't translate very well, so I tried to capture the spirit of the story. The Heliarch linguists were very helpful," she explains. "They really went into depth on some aspects of the Coalition's languages. None of the major plot points were changed, thankfully, though some content in the book had to be edited or removed. My Heliarch friend said that if I changed this or removed that, the book would sell so much better, and as they said, they wanted to 'make it more suitable for the Coalition.' Their words.|3848|0
units.context: conversation:anna invites you to book signing
units.english: "Well, for one, it's not in our language. Some concepts just don't translate very well, so I tried to capture the spirit of the story. The Heliarch linguists were very helpful," she explains. "They really went into depth on some aspects of the Coalition's languages. None of the major plot points were changed, thankfully, though some content in the book had to be edited or removed. My Heliarch friend said that if I changed this or removed that, the book would sell so much better, and as they said, they wanted to 'make it more suitable for the Coalition.' Their words.
units.italian: "Beh, tanto per cominciare, non è nella nostra lingua. Alcuni concetti non si traducono bene, quindi ho cercato di catturare lo spirito della storia. I linguisti Heliarchs sono stati molto utili," spiega. "Sono andati davvero in profondità su alcuni aspetti delle lingue della Coalizione. Nessuno dei punti principali della trama è stato cambiato, per fortuna, anche se alcuni contenuti nel libro sono stati modificati o rimossi. Il mio amico Heliarch diceva che se cambiavo questo o rimuovevo quello, il libro avrebbe venduto molto meglio, e come dicevano, volevano 'renderlo più adatto alla Coalizione'. Parole loro.

units.id: conversation:anna invites you to book signing|	"As for the special copy, it was so I could verify and look at the changes they made, in my language, so I wouldn't have to learn their language. They agreed to print another copy for me so I could give it to you."|3849|0
units.context: conversation:anna invites you to book signing
units.english: "As for the special copy, it was so I could verify and look at the changes they made, in my language, so I wouldn't have to learn their language. They agreed to print another copy for me so I could give it to you."
units.italian: "Quanto alla copia speciale, serviva perché potessi verificare e vedere le modifiche che avevano fatto, nella mia lingua, così non dovevo imparare la loro. Hanno accettato di stamparne un'altra per me, così potevo darla a te."

units.id: conversation:anna invites you to book signing|	Anna checks a wristwatch that she didn't have when you first met. units.context: conversation:anna invites you to book signing
units.english: Anna checks a wristwatch that she didn't have when you first met. "Wow, it looks like people have already started reviewing the book, and they're giving great feedback! I've got to go now; I want to see in person how well my book is selling. Goodbye!"
units.italian: Anna controlla un orologio da polso che non aveva quando l'hai conosciuta. "Wow, sembra che la gente abbia già cominciato a recensire il libro, e stanno dando ottimi riscontri! Ora devo andare; voglio vedere di persona quanto sta vendendo il mio libro. Arrivederci!"

units.id: conversation:anna invites you to book signing|	Anna then leaves your ship, leaving you with a novel, a payment, and the knowledge that you've helped a struggling author make it big.|3851|0
units.context: conversation:anna invites you to book signing
units.english: Anna then leaves your ship, leaving you with a novel, a payment, and the knowledge that you've helped a struggling author make it big.
units.italian: Anna lascia poi la nave, lasciandoti con un romanzo, un pagamento, e la consapevolezza di aver aiutato un'autrice in difficoltà a sfondare.

units.id: conversation:anna invites you to book signing|	Anna looks disappointed, but the emotion quickly disappears in her flood of exuberence. She dashes off in the direction she came in.|3854|0
units.context: conversation:anna invites you to book signing
units.english: Anna looks disappointed, but the emotion quickly disappears in her flood of exuberence. She dashes off in the direction she came in.
units.italian: Anna sembra delusa, ma l'emozione sparisce in fretta nel suo fiume di esuberanza. Scatta via nella direzione da cui è venuta.

units.english: You are shocked to see an extra <payment> in your account. She explains that the book has been selling very well in Coalition space and sends an expression of gratitude. Given the <payment> you received this is likely an understatement.
units.italian: Sei scioccato nel vedere un <payment> extra sul tuo conto. Controllando i messaggi noti una notifica di Anna, l'autrice il cui libro Oltre l'Iperguida è stato pubblicato nello spazio della Coalizione qualche mese fa. Spiega che il libro sta vendendo molto bene nello spazio della Coalizione e manda un'espressione di gratitudine. Dato il <payment> che hai ricevuto, è probabilmente un'attenuazione.
